description: This file provides functions for generating autocomplete suggestions for user mentions and channel mentions within a chat application, including handling user input parsing and integrating with Redux actions.

methods.name: inTextMentionSuggestions
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for user or channel mentions based on the current pretext input, dispatching Redux actions to fetch data.

methods.name: getUserSuggestions
methods.description: Generates a list of user suggestion objects from UserAutocomplete data, including handling cases where no users are found.

methods.name: getChannelSuggestions
methods.description: Generates a list of channel suggestion objects from a list of Channel objects, including handling cases where no channels are found.

methods.name: getUserSuggestion
methods.description: Creates a suggestion object for a single user profile.
